[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]We now have three of our own ramp kits to serve your project needs quickly and professionally. We can ramp down and up Siemens, GE, Toshiba/Canon, and Philips magnets. We prefer the use of OEM recommended ramp kits to de-risk the procedure, and we are proud that we can serve your projects with OEM trained engineers. We have significantly invested in our own tools. We always take a lot of care in our ramping work and follow the manufacturer’s guidance, coupled with our extensive experience. We regularly work throughout the UK and on the European continent. We have also worked in eastern Europe and Africa.

We can also help with the shimming of your magnet as part of our installation services. Please talk to us about your project requirements.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
